serviceOwner.title: Service Provider
serviceOwner.description: Ten10 is an open-source software for managing tithes and personal budgets. The service is operated by the operator of the Ten10 service.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.description: Ten10 collects and uses the following information:
dataCollection.item1: Email address (required for web account - without it there is no account)
dataCollection.item2: Full name and profile picture (your choice)
dataCollection.item3: Financial data: Income, expenses, donations, and any other data you choose to record in the system
dataCollection.item4: Technical usage data: Application activity for service improvement purposes
dataCollection.item5: Contact content: Messages you choose to send through the contact form

web.title: Website Version
web.location: Cloud infrastructure providers, some located outside Israel, using reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data.
web.access: Admin access: Limited to operations, security, and support. Infrastructure providers may have access according to their role.

desktop.title: Desktop Application
desktop.description: Desktop version: data is stored locally and not uploaded automatically.

internationalTransfer.title: International Data Transfer
internationalTransfer.description: Our cloud services operate on servers outside of Israel:
internationalTransfer.note: These providers operate outside of Israel. We make no claims regarding GDPR compliance.
internationalTransfer.financialDataNote: Ten10 does not use your financial data for profiling, targeting, or marketing segmentation.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention and Deletion
dataRetention.description: We retain your data as follows:
dataRetention.item1: Account data and financial data: Retained as long as your account is active, or until you choose to delete them
dataRetention.item2: Data deletion: You can delete individual data or your entire account through Settings. Data is deleted from active systems, and copies may remain for a limited time in backups and logs until removed
dataRetention.item3: Contact messages: Retained for support purposes
dataRetention.item4: Receipts uploaded to the assistant: the image or PDF is stored privately for up to 30 days and then deleted. Deleting the file does not delete a transaction you already approved

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
dataUsage.description: We use your data for the following purposes:
dataUsage.item1: Operating the service: Providing access, authentication, and security
dataUsage.item2: Calculations and reports: Tithe calculations, generating financial reports and summaries
dataUsage.item3: Support: Responding to inquiries and technical support
dataUsage.item4: Maintenance and improvement: Service maintenance and improvement
dataUsage.item5: Service reminders: Sending monthly reminders that the user enabled (can be disabled in Settings)
dataUsage.item6: Ten10 news: Marketing updates about the project according to mailing preferences and law (can be unsubscribed)

communications.title: Communications and Email
communications.description: We send two types of emails:

reminder.title: Service Messages and Reminders
reminder.description: Account-related messages and tithe reminders that the user enabled. Reminders can be disabled in Settings, independent of marketing preferences.

marketing.title: Marketing Updates (Ten10 News)
marketing.description: The option to receive marketing updates is provided in the signup screen. When providing your email address, a notice is displayed that the address may also be used to send marketing updates, and you are given the option to decline. These terms alone do not serve as a substitute for this notice.

communications.unsubscribe: To unsubscribe from reminders, marketing, or both, click the appropriate link in any email, or change your preferences in Settings, or contact us: contact@ten10-app.com

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Google Analytics (landing page) and PostHog (web app) for general usage tracking — no financial data. Desktop has no tracking.
analytics.note: These tools use cookies. You can block tracking cookies in your browser.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Ten10 uses cookies and local storage required for the service to function, and may also use measurement and analytics technologies that are not essential.
cookies.item1: Authentication cookies — Maintaining login and account security
cookies.item3: Google Analytics — Measurement and statistics on the landing page, if enabled
cookies.item4: PostHog — Usage analysis in the web version, according to service settings
cookies.note: You can block cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect service functionality.

ageRequirement.title: Age Requirement
ageRequirement.description: This service is intended for adult users (18 years and older). If you are under 18, you must use the service with parental or legal guardian consent and supervision.

userRights.title: User Rights
userRights.description: You have the following rights regarding your data:
userRights.item1: Access and review: Your right to review all your personal data through the application
userRights.item2: Correction: Your right to request correction of inaccurate data
userRights.item3: View, edit, and delete: In-app options for viewing, editing, deleting, and exporting data are available
userRights.item4: Export: Export data to various formats (CSV, Excel, PDF)
userRights.item5: Account deletion: Delete account and associated data through Settings
userRights.item6: Preference changes: Change communication preferences in Settings
userRights.item7: Complaint: Your right to file a complaint with the Israeli Privacy Protection Authority if you believe your rights have been violated

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: If you have questions or concerns about the privacy policy, please contact us:
